description: Defines a data class GatewayEndpoint representing gateway connection details, including methods for manual creation and various network configurations.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A data class encapsulating gateway connection parameters such as host, port, security settings, and optional network details. Includes a companion object with a factory method for manual instantiation.

methods.name: manual
